articles.title: India bonds slip as Treasury rout offsets oil slide
articles.content: Indian government bonds declined on Wednesday as a sharp rise in US Treasury yields, triggered by hotter-than-expected inflation and hawkish signals from policymakers, overshadowed relief from lower crude oil prices. Higher US yields could erode the relative return advantage of Indian debt, dampening its appeal among foreign investors.

articles.title: Rupee rises 7 paise to 93.70 against US dollar in early trade
articles.content: The rupee strengthened 7 paise to 93.70 against the US dollar in early trade on Wednesday, supported by sustained foreign fund inflows, easing crude oil prices and improving geopolitical sentiment. The domestic currency has emerged as one of Asia's best performers in FY27, with traders expecting continued overseas investor participation to provide a buffer against external uncertainties.
